reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 55 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
